newsitem.title: UK: UK's NAO says it provides value for money.
newsitem.headline: UK's NAO says it provides value for money.

text.p: The National Audit Office gave itself a clean bill of financial health on Wednesday, reporting that it had saved the British taxpayer over 850 million stg in the past three years.
In its annual report, the watchdog on public expenditure said it had achieved its target of making more than seven times as much savings as it cost to operate.
"In 1996 audited bodies made over 2,600 significant changes to their procedures as a result of our value for money work," the report said.

"The savings arising from recent reports constituted more than seven times the cost of the Office. Over the past three years these savings have totalled some 858 million stg in addition to on-going savings arising from earlier recommendations."
